title: PNP vows tight security at Asean Summit venues, urges peaceful protests
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) vows to maintain tight security at venues of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, urging protesters to hold demonstrations peacefully…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) vows to maintain tight security at venues of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, urging protesters to hold demonstrations peacefully and cooperate with authorities. “The PNP did not fail to appeal to and remind our fellow citizens to ensure that protests are held at the appropriate time and place,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said on Monday. “They repeatedly appealed to the protesters, issued warnings, and offered opportunities for them to cooperate peacefully,” he added.
